_comment: The ONLY exemption mechanism for validate_repo_db.py check 9. Exact (harness_id, harness_version) pairs -- no date scoping, no wildcards, no version ranges.

Date scoping was the original proposal and was rejected: a rule of the form 'first run on or after 2026-09-01' has a boundary for a harness to land on, and H-EMPREVIEW-01 was straddling that exact boundary while the gate was being specified.

Every pair here predates the gate and was audited by hand instead -- that hand audit, and what it cut, is what the gate exists to make structural. Adding a pair is a logged decision, never a way around a failing audit.

_population_note: `population_at_exemption` is the number of Observations the version held in the workbook committed on
2026-08-31 (commit f109174) -- the day every exemption below was granted, and the population each
`reason` describes. It is recorded because those populations have since MOVED: these harnesses rewrite
rows under the version that last wrote them, so a row's harness_version means 'the version that last
wrote it', not 'the version that was audited'. Measured 2026-09-20: 7 of the 18 pairs hold a different
number today and one (H-FMCSA-01 v1.3) holds rows written AFTER its exemption. Nothing was lost -- every
departed row moved to a newer version or is one of the 23 pre-rule renumberings recorded in
Observation_Ids.current_id. The `reason` texts are left exactly as written: they are dated statements
about what was audited, not descriptions of today. Full measurement:
check 9 reads only harness_id and harness_version from this file; these fields are documentation.
